## Detailed Overview
PresentoLab is a premium presentation design and digital design agency delivering high-impact visual communication for businesses, startups, and enterprise teams. We specialize in investor decks, corporate presentations, and brand-driven visual systems that help clients communicate clearly, persuade stakeholders, and win opportunities.

## Detailed Services

### Presentation Design
- Investor pitch decks
- Corporate presentations
- Sales and marketing decks
- Company profiles
- Training and onboarding presentations
- Branded PowerPoint & Google Slides templates

### Startup & Investment Materials
- Fundraising pitch decks
- Financial storytelling slides
- Market opportunity visualizations
- Executive summaries and one-pagers

### Visual & Brand Systems
- Brand-aligned slide systems
- Iconography and infographics
- Data visualization and charts
- Design systems for scalable teams

### Digital Design
- Website visuals & landing page graphics
- Social media design kits
- Marketing assets & ad creatives
- Portfolio and case study layouts

### Systems & Handoff
- Fully editable source files
- Organized slide masters and components
- Scalable design systems for teams
- Version-controlled delivery for collaboration

## Process (Typical)
1. Discovery & Strategy → define goals, audience, and messaging.
2. Structure & Wireframes → outline story flow and key slides.
3. Visual Design → apply branding, layout systems, and visuals.
4. Refinement → feedback iterations aligned with milestones.
5. Delivery → editable files and optimized exports.
6. Support → optional revisions and future scalability guidance.

## Technical Notes
- Deliverables: PPTX, Google Slides, PDF, PNG assets.
- Compatibility: Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote (exported).
- Fonts: brand fonts or licensed alternatives.
- Visuals: vector-based graphics for scalability.
- Security: NDA-friendly workflows and secure file transfer.

## FAQs (Extended)
- Lead Time: Standard decks take 3–7 days depending on complexity.
- Revisions: Iterative revisions included based on project scope.
- Rush Projects: Expedited timelines available when required.
- Tools: PowerPoint, Google Slides, Figma, Adobe Illustrator.
- Confidentiality: Client data and materials handled securely.

## Outcome Examples
- Investor-ready decks that improve funding success.
- Clear storytelling that enhances stakeholder understanding.
- Brand-consistent presentation systems for growing teams.
- Editable assets enabling long-term internal use.
